items.title: 3 of Wall Street’s Favorite Stocks We’re Skeptical Of
items.summary: The stocks in this article have caught Wall Street’s attention in a big way, with price targets implying returns above 20%. But investors should take these forecasts with a grain of salt because analysts typically say nice things about companies so their firms can win business in other product lines like M&A advisory.

items.title: Zoetis (ZTS) Stock Still Looks Cheap After a 62% Slide

items.title: 2 Large-Cap Stocks for Long-Term Investors and 1 We Avoid
items.summary: Large-cap stocks have the power to shape entire industries thanks to their size and widespread influence. With such vast footprints, however, finding new areas for growth is much harder than for smaller, more agile players.
